title: LYCEUM export (lyceum-export) 1.0 — lyceum.json
description: The document of an export bundle: the envelope and every exported table. Unknown keys are allowed, so a later 1.x may add one. Rules 1-5 are those of exchange/README.md. The bytes (UTF-8 without a byte-order mark, keys sorted, a final LF) and the schema version not newer than the reader's are not stated here (exchange/README.md).

tables.description: Table name to its rows, in primary-key order, soft-deleted rows included. A row is one object, column name to the value as stored: integer, real, text, BLOB as base64 text, or null. Each table's row is stated by schemas/tables/<table>.schema.json through lyceum-tables.schema.json, both generated from the database.

formatVersion.description: Rule 2: MAJOR.MINOR in plain decimal; this schema reads major 1, any minor.

schemaVersion.description: Rule 3: LyceumDatabase.currentVersion of the app that wrote the bundle.

instant.description: UTC ISO 8601 with Z, fraction of a second optional (up to microseconds). The calendar check (no 30 February) is the reader's.
